generations.zh: 当前代：2B / 1B 密集小杯（MiniCPM5-2B 2.5B 密集），官方称「2B-class open-source SOTA」（自评基准口径）；Base / SFT / DSpark 等中间档官方全部放出；配套开源 UltraData 系列训练数据。
generations.en: Current generation: 2B / 1B dense small builds (MiniCPM5-2B is 2.5B dense), pitched as "2B-class open-source SOTA" (vendor-run benchmark wording); Base / SFT / DSpark intermediate checkpoints all released; the UltraData training-data family ships alongside.

generations.zh: 并行视觉与全模态支线（V-4.7 / o-4_5 等在册），与语言主线同 org。
generations.en: Parallel vision and omni-modal branches (V-4.7 / o-4_5 etc.) in the same org.

generations.zh: 上一代语言主线（MiniCPM4-8B / 4.1-8B / MiniCPM3-4B 在册）。

claims.zh: 官方 README：「compared with strong open-source models of similar size, MiniCPM5-2B achieves SOTA performance within this comparison set」（厂商自评基准口径）；官方放出 UltraX / UltraData-Code / UltraData-SFT-Agent / UltraData-RL 训练数据集。
claims.en: Official README: "compared with strong open-source models of similar size, MiniCPM5-2B achieves SOTA performance within this comparison set" (vendor-run benchmark wording); the UltraX / UltraData-Code / UltraData-SFT-Agent / UltraData-RL datasets are released by the vendor.

positioning.zh: 国产端侧小杯家族：尺寸小、官方连训练数据一起开源，是「自己练一遍」路线最友好的中文家族。面壁 ChatGLM 之外的另一条国产备案线（MiniCPM 备案编号 Beijing-MiniCPM-202503180058）。
positioning.en: The domestic on-device small-model family: small sizes plus fully open training data — the friendliest Chinese family for the "train one yourself" route. Alongside Zhipu, another filed domestic line (MiniCPM filing number Beijing-MiniCPM-202503180058).

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 MiniCPM5-2B 的量化对比
